name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Measure visible local geometry without repeated raw depth queries. Supply camera and 1–4 regions_rc, each [row_start,column_start,row_end,column_end] in native pixels, exclusive ends (4x4 minimum, 4096 pixels maximum each). Returns world centres/normals and fit quality. For a straight channel/shaft, select 3–4 separated small surface patches on the SAME feature: diverse consistent normals yield a common tangent. Parallel/mixed/poor support yields unknown. Axis sign is arbitrary; neither the axis nor a patch normal is automatically a movement target or insertion depth. Latest frame by default; step selects one of latest four.
